title: Don’t Follow Your Passion | Ben Horowitz’s Advice for New Graduates

reader_summary.headline: Thinking for yourself sounds both simple and trivial, but in reality, it's extremely difficult and it's profound.
reader_summary.overview: Thinking for yourself sounds both simple and trivial, but in reality, it's extremely difficult and it's profound. As human beings, we want to be liked. If people didn't like you and caveman days, they would just eat you.

key_points.text: So you really have a natural built and instinct who want to be liked.
key_points.evidence_quote: So you really have a natural built and instinct who want to be liked.

key_points.text: And the easiest way to be liked is to tell people what they want to hear.
key_points.evidence_quote: And the easiest way to be liked is to tell people what they want to hear.

key_points.text: And you know what everybody wants to hear?
key_points.evidence_quote: And you know what everybody wants to hear?

key_points.text: What they already believe to be true.
